records.title: A Comparison of the Cerebras Wafer-Scale Integration Technology with Nvidia GPU-based Systems for Artificial Intelligence
records.reason: Hardware-level LLM relevance is plausible, but no LLM-specific serving workload or comparable inference metrics are established.

records.title: Short-Term Load Forecasting for AI-Data Center
records.reason: The abstract proposes short-term electricity-load forecasting for AI data centers with conventional forecasting models; this is facility load prediction, not an LLM inference optimization.

records.title: A Hybrid Swarm Intelligence Approach for Optimizing Multimodal Large Language Models Deployment in Edge-Cloud-based Federated Learning Environments
records.reason: The abstract centers on federated training, edge fine-tuning, device selection and transmission of model updates; the efficiency results concern training communication/participation, not inference serving.

records.title: When Precision Meets Position: BFloat16 Breaks Down RoPE in Long-Context Training
records.reason: The abstract addresses RoPE numerical behavior and AnchorAttention speedups during long-context training; its stated improvement is training-time only.

records.title: IntentGPT: Few-shot Intent Discovery with Large Language Models
records.reason: IntentGPT is a prompt-based intent-discovery method evaluated on classification benchmarks; the abstract does not claim inference/serving efficiency.
